intro: Mars Pathfinder landed in Ares Vallis on July 4, 1997 — the first US mission to Mars since the Vikings 21 years earlier. The lander deployed Sojourner, the first wheels on Mars, demonstrating airbag-landing + roving in a $265M low-cost "faster-better-cheaper" mission that returned ~16,500 images. Sojourner's 100-meter traverse mapped twelve rocks named after cartoon characters (Yogi, Barnacle Bill, Scooby Doo) before the lander died.
